verses.1: Once again, he began to teach from the shore. A large crowd gathered around him, so that he could sit in a boat on the sea. Everyone in the crowd stood facing the sea.
verses.2: And he taught them many things through parables. He also spoke to them during his teachings.
verses.3: Listen. It seems that the shepherd has come out.
verses.4: And it happened during the flight that some of them fell along the way. Then, the birds came and ate them.
verses.5: And another one fell onto the rock, where there wasn’t much soil at all. Immediately, it shattered because there was no depth in the ground.
verses.6: And when the sun stopped shining, it became dry and barren due to the lack of its rays.
verses.7: And another one fell into the pits. The pits rose up, and they suffocated it. It didn’t give any fruit at all.
verses.8: And other seeds fell on good soil. They produced fruits that grew and multiplied. They produced thirty, sixty, and one hundred seeds.
verses.9: And he said, “Whoever wants to listen, let him listen.”
verses.10: And when it happened to him alone, those who were around him asked him about the twelve parables.
verses.11: And he said to them: “To you, the secret of God’s kingdom is revealed. But to those who are outside, everything is explained through metaphors.”
verses.12: So that when they see, they will not see; when they hear, they will not understand. Even if they return, it will still be of no use to them.
verses.13: And he said to them, “Do you not understand this parable? And how do you know all the parables?”
verses.14: He who speaks words, he continues to speak.
verses.15: These are those who are along the path where the word is spread. When they hear it, Satan immediately comes and destroys the word that has been spread to them.
verses.16: And these are also those who are devoted to the things of the earth. When they hear the Word, they immediately accept it with joy.
verses.17: And they do not have any support within themselves; instead, they are weak. Once they suffer from sorrow or persecution because of their beliefs, they immediately fall apart.
verses.18: And there are also others who are devoted to those who are in need. These are those who listen to the words.
verses.19: And the desires of the summer months, along with the deceptions of wealth, and all those other desires that arise, all these things suppress the truth of the matter. And it becomes like a flower that has been destroyed.
verses.20: And those are those who have scattered the good land. They listen to the word, accept it, and produce thirty, sixty, or one hundred units from each unit of land.
verses.21: And he said to them, “Is it necessary for the coffin to be placed either under the canopy or on the bed? Or does it not need to be placed directly on the coffin itself?”
verses.22: It isn’t secretive if it doesn’t become visible; nor does something become “secret” just because it enters the realm of visibility.
verses.23: If anyone has this problem, then they should listen carefully.
verses.24: And he said to them, “See what you are hearing. In that measure you will be measured, and it will be added to you.”
verses.25: For those who do have it, it will be given to them. And those who don’t have it, it will be taken away from them.
verses.26: And he said: Thus is the kingdom of God, as when a man lays his seed on the ground.
verses.27: And it is also shaken and turned upside down, night and day. The seeds are scattered everywhere, and they don’t know what to do with them.
verses.28: The land grows crops autonomously. First, it produces grains; then, they become pods; and finally, the pods become full fruits within them.
verses.29: When the fruit is ready, he immediately sends out the seeds, because the fertilization has taken place.
verses.30: And he said, “How can we make the kingdom of God similar to anything else? Or in what way can we compare it to anything else?”
verses.31: Like a drop of blood, when it spreads across the ground, it becomes smaller than all other drops of blood that spread across the ground.
verses.32: And when it spreads out, it becomes larger than all the other grains of wheat. It also forms branches that are very large, so that it can support the weight of the clouds in the sky under its shade.
verses.33: And in many such parables, he made his words clear to them, as they were able to understand.
verses.34: But as a metaphorical illustration, he didn’t do this to them. Instead, he dealt with each individual disciple individually.
verses.35: And he said to them on that day of vision: “Let us go out into the outside world.”
verses.36: And after dispersing the crowd, they take him as he was on the ship. There were also other ships along with him.
verses.37: And a huge gust of wind occurred, and the waves rushed into the ship, so that it was already filled with water.
verses.38: And he was also present in the assembly, standing on the platform. They turned to him and said to him, “Teacher, don’t you know that we are about to be destroyed?”
verses.39: And being enraged, he struck the wind with his sword and said to the sea, “Silence! Be silent!” Then the wind ceased, and great peace was established.
verses.40: And he said to them, “What kind of sheep are you? Do you still have faith?”
verses.41: And they were terrified by a great fear. They said to each other, “Who is this person, that even the wind and the sea obey him?”
